title: Dune Walker
summary: A 96-second procedural desert sci-fi short in 2.39:1 cinemascope: a lone figure on a dune crest meets a colossal biomechanical walker.
description: An interactive 100% procedural Three.js cinematic short with zero external assets, rendered in 2.39:1 anamorphic framing with AgX Filmic tone mapping, cascaded shadow maps, ray-marched volumetric dust shafts, procedural PMREM sky IBL, and Web Audio synthesis. A lone hooded figure in a Verlet-simulated crimson robe stands on a wind-rippled dune ridge as a 110 m carved stone-and-bronze walker emerges past distant megastructures, kneels before her at sunset, and departs into cobalt blue hour before a haboob dust storm resets the cycle into morning light. Drag to orbit around the scene (auto-returns after 5 s), scroll to zoom, or tap/click to blend to the next shot.
